question: Step 1 of exp-monday-limit-1m-account-label-20261031-v1: NautilusTrader fills of every Monday 1.618 signal event under the paper accounts' exact v3 and spike rules, used as training labels and as the fills every arm's accounts select from.
single_variable: None (label run); orders admitted for every event by admit-all scores, rules frozen as exp-monday-limit-paper-accounts-20261028-v1.
excluded_symbols: BTC, ETH, XAU, XAG, PAXG, XAUT (none are in the Codex alt inputs)
fees: Codex config maker 0.02 / taker 0.05 percent (OKX Lv1, read 2026-10-23)
not_modelled: OKX vs Binance data and symbol lists; the paper engine's 1m intrabar order; manual reductions
in_sample: Rules, thresholds and filters were chosen on the same history; forward paper data is the test
admit_all: causal 0.55 and stored 0.65 for every event: v3 rows in both target bands (range 0.618, opposite 1.618 with its add leg) and the spike row; selection happens later in the summary of the main experiment
